```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Find only the sport_totals files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sport_total_files <- list.files(
  path = base_dir,
  pattern = "wada_testing_[0-9]{4}_sport_totals\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# Sort files by year
get_year_from_file <- function(x) {
  as.integer(str_extract(basename(x), "[0-9]{4}"))
}

sport_total_files <- sport_total_files[order(get_year_from_file(sport_total_files))]

# Check files found
print(sport_total_files)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Combine raw files WITHOUT changing columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_raw_with_source <- map_dfr(
  sport_total_files,
  function(file_path) {
    read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(
        source_file = basename(file_path),
        source_year = get_year_from_file(file_path)
      )
  }
)

# Raw combined file without source-file columns
wada_raw_combined <- wada_raw_with_source %>%
  select(-source_file, -source_year)

# Save raw combined files
write_csv(
  wada_raw_combined,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_raw_combined.csv")
)

write_csv(
  wada_raw_with_source,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_raw_combined_with_source.csv")
)

```



```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Create standardized source-level file
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_clean <- wada_raw_with_source %>%
  clean_names()

# Helper function to combine year-specific columns
coalesce_numeric_matching <- function(data, pattern) {
  cols <- names(data)[str_detect(names(data), pattern)]
  
  if (length(cols) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(data)))
  }
  
  cols_data <- data[cols] %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  
  do.call(dplyr::coalesce, cols_data)
}

wada_standardized_source_level <- wada_clean %>%
  mutate(
    testing_share = coalesce_numeric_matching(
      wada_clean,
      "^testing_share(_[0-9]{4})?$"
    ),
    
    aaf_share_extracted_denominator = coalesce_numeric_matching(
      wada_clean,
      "^aaf_share(_[0-9]{4})?_extracted_denominator$|^aaf_share_extracted_denominator$"
    ),
    
    mismatch_score = coalesce_numeric_matching(
      wada_clean,
      "^mismatch_score(_[0-9]{4})?$"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    any_of(c(
      "source_file",
      "source_year",
      "year",
      "sport_raw",
      "sport_clean",
      "sport_group_table",
      "total_samples",
      "in_competition_samples",
      "out_competition_samples",
      "urine_samples",
      "blood_samples",
      "dbs_samples",
      "aaf_count",
      "aaf_rate",
      "testing_share",
      "aaf_share_extracted_denominator",
      "mismatch_score",
      "total_samples_calc",
      "total_samples_reported",
      "sample_total_check",
      "aaf_count_calc",
      "aaf_count_reported",
      "aaf_total_check",
      "source_report"
    ))
  )

write_csv(
  wada_standardized_source_level,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_standardized_source_level.csv")
)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Project 1: WADA Testing Figures 2016–2024
# Cleaning + aggregation script
# Input: standardized source-level file
# Output: cleaned source-level + cleaned aggregated sport-year file
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(stringr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. File paths
# ------------------------------------------------------------

base_dir <- "C:/Users/Apu/Desktop/asl/rstudio files/seminar/project1/data"

input_file <- file.path(
  base_dir,
  "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_standardized_source_level.csv"
)

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "cleaned")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read source-level dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_source <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  clean_names()

glimpse(wada_source)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_number <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(x)
  }
  
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all(",", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("%", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("−", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("–", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("—", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("^-$", "0") %>%
    str_trim() %>%
    na_if("") %>%
    as.numeric()
}

normalize_sport_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("\u00A0", " ") %>%      # non-breaking space
    str_replace_all("‐|-|‒|–|—", "-") %>%  # different hyphen types
    str_replace_all("\\s*/\\s*", " / ") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s*-\\s*", "-") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
    str_trim()
}

standardize_sport_name <- function(x) {
  x <- normalize_sport_name(x)
  
  case_when(
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("armwrestling", "arm wrestling") ~ "Arm Wrestling",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("canoe/kayak", "canoe / kayak", "canoe kayak") ~ "Canoe / Kayak",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("ju-jitsu", "ju jitsu", "ju-jitsu") ~ "Ju-Jitsu",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para athletics", "para-athletics") ~ "Para-Athletics",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para swimming", "para-swimming") ~ "Para-Swimming",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para powerlifting", "para-powerlifting") ~ "Para-Powerlifting",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para cycling", "para-cycling") ~ "Para-Cycling",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para archery", "para-archery") ~ "Para-Archery",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para badminton", "para-badminton") ~ "Para-Badminton",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para canoe", "para-canoe") ~ "Para-Canoe",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para equestrian", "para-equestrian") ~ "Para-Equestrian",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para rowing", "para-rowing") ~ "Para-Rowing",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para table tennis", "para-table tennis") ~ "Para-Table Tennis",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("para taekwondo", "para-taekwondo") ~ "Para-Taekwondo",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("football 5-a-side", "football 5 a side") ~ "Football 5-a-Side",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("shooting para sport", "shooting para-sport") ~ "Shooting Para Sport",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("dance sport", "dancesport") ~ "DanceSport",
    str_to_lower(x) %in% c("waterskiing", "water skiing") ~ "Water Skiing",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

safe_sum <- function(x) {
  sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

safe_first <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    x[1]
  }
}

collapse_unique <- function(x) {
  x <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""])
  if (length(x) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    paste(sort(x), collapse = " | ")
  }
}
```


```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Clean numeric columns and sport names
# ------------------------------------------------------------

numeric_cols <- c(
  "total_samples",
  "in_competition_samples",
  "out_competition_samples",
  "urine_samples",
  "blood_samples",
  "dbs_samples",
  "aaf_count",
  "aaf_rate",
  "testing_share",
  "aaf_share_extracted_denominator",
  "mismatch_score",
  "total_samples_calc",
  "total_samples_reported",
  "aaf_count_calc",
  "aaf_count_reported"
)

wada_cleaned_source <- wada_source %>%
  mutate(
    across(any_of(numeric_cols), clean_number),
    
    sport_name_input = case_when(
      !is.na(sport_clean) & sport_clean != "" ~ sport_clean,
      !is.na(sport_raw) & sport_raw != "" ~ sport_raw,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    sport_clean_original = sport_clean,
    sport_clean = standardize_sport_name(sport_name_input),
    
    source_year_check = if_else(
      !is.na(source_year) & !is.na(year),
      source_year == year,
      NA
    ),
    
    sample_split_diff = total_samples -
      coalesce(in_competition_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(out_competition_samples, 0),
    
    material_split_diff = total_samples -
      coalesce(urine_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(blood_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(dbs_samples, 0),
    
    sample_split_complete = sample_split_diff == 0,
    material_split_complete = material_split_diff == 0,
    
    split_data_complete = sample_split_complete & material_split_complete,
    
    aaf_rate_recalculated = if_else(
      total_samples > 0,
      aaf_count / total_samples,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    aaf_rate_diff = aaf_rate - aaf_rate_recalculated
  )

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Sport-name crosswalk
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sport_name_crosswalk <- wada_cleaned_source %>%
  distinct(
    sport_raw,
    sport_clean_original,
    sport_clean
  ) %>%
  arrange(sport_clean, sport_raw)

write_csv(
  sport_name_crosswalk,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_name_crosswalk.csv")
)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Duplicate sport-year report before aggregation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

duplicate_sport_year_report <- wada_cleaned_source %>%
  group_by(year, sport_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_source_rows = n(),
    sport_groups = collapse_unique(sport_group_table),
    total_samples = safe_sum(total_samples),
    aaf_count = safe_sum(aaf_count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_source_rows > 1) %>%
  arrange(year, desc(n_source_rows), sport_clean)

write_csv(
  duplicate_sport_year_report,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_duplicate_sport_year_report.csv")
)

```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save cleaned source-level file
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  wada_cleaned_source,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_cleaned_source_level.csv")
)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Aggregate to one row per year + sport_clean
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_aggregated <- wada_cleaned_source %>%
  group_by(year, sport_clean) %>%
  summarise(
    n_source_rows = n(),
    sport_group_tables = collapse_unique(sport_group_table),
    source_reports = collapse_unique(source_report),
    source_files = collapse_unique(source_file),
    
    total_samples = safe_sum(total_samples),
    in_competition_samples = safe_sum(in_competition_samples),
    out_competition_samples = safe_sum(out_competition_samples),
    urine_samples = safe_sum(urine_samples),
    blood_samples = safe_sum(blood_samples),
    dbs_samples = safe_sum(dbs_samples),
    aaf_count = safe_sum(aaf_count),
    
    source_level_split_issues = sum(!split_data_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    yearly_total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    yearly_total_aafs = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    aaf_rate = if_else(
      total_samples > 0,
      aaf_count / total_samples,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    testing_share = if_else(
      yearly_total_samples > 0,
      total_samples / yearly_total_samples,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    aaf_share = if_else(
      yearly_total_aafs > 0,
      aaf_count / yearly_total_aafs,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    mismatch_score = aaf_share - testing_share,
    
    sample_split_diff = total_samples -
      coalesce(in_competition_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(out_competition_samples, 0),
    
    material_split_diff = total_samples -
      coalesce(urine_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(blood_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(dbs_samples, 0),
    
    split_data_complete = sample_split_diff == 0 & material_split_diff == 0,
    
    in_competition_share = if_else(
      total_samples > 0,
      in_competition_samples / total_samples,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    out_competition_share = if_else(
      total_samples > 0,
      out_competition_samples / total_samples,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    urine_share = if_else(
      total_samples > 0,
      urine_samples / total_samples,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    blood_share = if_else(
      total_samples > 0,
      blood_samples / total_samples,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    dbs_share = if_else(
      total_samples > 0,
      dbs_samples / total_samples,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(year, desc(total_samples), sport_clean)

write_csv(
  wada_aggregated,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_cleaned_aggregated.csv")
)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Validation summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

source_validation <- wada_cleaned_source %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    source_rows = n(),
    source_total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    source_aaf_count = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

aggregated_validation <- wada_aggregated %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    aggregated_rows = n(),
    aggregated_total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    aggregated_aaf_count = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    testing_share_sum = sum(testing_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    aaf_share_sum = sum(aaf_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    mismatch_score_sum = sum(mismatch_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows_with_split_issues = sum(!split_data_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

validation_summary <- source_validation %>%
  left_join(aggregated_validation, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    samples_preserved = source_total_samples == aggregated_total_samples,
    aafs_preserved = source_aaf_count == aggregated_aaf_count,
    testing_share_valid = abs(testing_share_sum - 1) < 0.000001,
    aaf_share_valid = abs(aaf_share_sum - 1) < 0.000001,
    mismatch_score_valid = abs(mismatch_score_sum) < 0.000001
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

write_csv(
  validation_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_cleaning_aggregation_validation_summary.csv")
)

print(validation_summary)
```

```{r}
cat("Output folder:", out_dir, "\n")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Apply sport-name fixes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_harmonised <- wada_r %>%
  mutate(
    sport_analysis_name = recode(
      sport_clean,
      !!!sport_name_fixes_list,
      .default = sport_clean
    )
  )

# Optional audit file: shows which names were changed
sport_name_harmonisation_report <- wada_harmonised %>%
  count(sport_clean, sport_analysis_name, name = "rows") %>%
  arrange(sport_analysis_name, sport_clean)

write_csv(
  sport_name_harmonisation_report,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_name_harmonisation_report.csv")
)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Re-aggregate by year + harmonised sport name
# ------------------------------------------------------------

wada_final <- wada_harmonised %>%
  group_by(year, sport_analysis_name) %>%
  summarise(
    old_sport_names = collapse_unique(sport_clean),
    n_source_rows = sum(n_source_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
    sport_group_tables = collapse_unique(sport_group_tables),
    source_reports = collapse_unique(source_reports),
    source_files = collapse_unique(source_files),
    
    total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    in_competition_samples = sum(in_competition_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    out_competition_samples = sum(out_competition_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    urine_samples = sum(urine_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    blood_samples = sum(blood_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    dbs_samples = sum(dbs_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    aaf_count = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    source_level_split_issues = sum(source_level_split_issues, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(sport_clean = sport_analysis_name) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    yearly_total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    yearly_total_aafs = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    aaf_rate = if_else(total_samples > 0, aaf_count / total_samples, NA_real_),
    testing_share = if_else(yearly_total_samples > 0, total_samples / yearly_total_samples, NA_real_),
    aaf_share = if_else(yearly_total_aafs > 0, aaf_count / yearly_total_aafs, NA_real_),
    mismatch_score = aaf_share - testing_share,
    
    sample_split_diff = total_samples -
      coalesce(in_competition_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(out_competition_samples, 0),
    
    material_split_diff = total_samples -
      coalesce(urine_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(blood_samples, 0) -
      coalesce(dbs_samples, 0),
    
    split_data_complete = sample_split_diff == 0 & material_split_diff == 0,
    
    in_competition_share = if_else(total_samples > 0, in_competition_samples / total_samples, NA_real_),
    out_competition_share = if_else(total_samples > 0, out_competition_samples / total_samples, NA_real_),
    urine_share = if_else(total_samples > 0, urine_samples / total_samples, NA_real_),
    blood_share = if_else(total_samples > 0, blood_samples / total_samples, NA_real_),
    dbs_share = if_else(total_samples > 0, dbs_samples / total_samples, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(year, desc(total_samples), sport_clean)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Validation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

validation_final <- wada_final %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    total_samples = sum(total_samples, na.rm = TRUE),
    aaf_count = sum(aaf_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    testing_share_sum = sum(testing_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    aaf_share_sum = sum(aaf_share, na.rm = TRUE),
    mismatch_score_sum = sum(mismatch_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    rows_with_split_issues = sum(!split_data_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(validation_final)

cat("\nFinal rows:", nrow(wada_final), "\n")
cat("Final unique sports:", n_distinct(wada_final$sport_clean), "\n")
```
```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Save final harmonised analysis file
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  wada_final,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_sport_year_2016_2024_final_sport_names.csv")
)

write_csv(
  validation_final,
  file.path(out_dir, "wada_testing_final_sport_name_validation.csv")
)
```
